gloss: emphasis line drawn beside text; (in horizontal writing) underline

definitions.gloss: emphasis line drawn beside text; (in horizontal writing) underline
definitions.explanation: A line drawn next to a passage to mark it out. In vertical Japanese writing it runs down the right side of the characters; in horizontal writing it appears as an underline.

examples.japanese: {傍線|ぼうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{傍線|ぼうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
{傍線|ぼうせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{現代語|げんだいご}→現代語：17782_gendaigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{訳|やく}し→訳す：02319_yakusu⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Translate the underlined portion into modern Japanese.

notes:
Composed of {傍|ぼう} (beside) + ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line) — literally a line at the side, reflecting vertical writing, where emphasis marks go alongside the characters rather than underneath them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傍線|ぼうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw an emphasis line
- {傍線|ぼうせん}⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧: the marked portion
- {傍線|ぼうせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{箇所|かしょ}→箇所：00196_kasho⟧: the passage with the line beside it
- {傍線|ぼうせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{筆者|ひっしゃ}→筆者：04348_hissha⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧: emphasis added by the author

USAGE:
Most often met in exam questions and academic quotations, where {傍線|ぼうせん}⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ ("the marked portion") identifies the passage a question is about. In everyday horizontal text, ⟦{下線|かせん}→下線：00190_kasen⟧ (underline) is the more usual word.
